description.value:
The Rendery isn't looking for a soldier. It's looking for a body that can survive doing what a soldier does for a living after the Choir's already asked it for more than once. Cyber City isn't looking for a customer. It's looking for a walking demonstration that doesn't seize up mid-sale on the showroom floor. Neither shop makes the offer out of fondness — they're betting on you the way a butcher bets on livestock, for the same reason a butcher does it: because you've already shown you're durable.

What they're buying isn't loyalty. It's the one thing a catalog price tag can't guarantee — a body that keeps standing after the sticker price says it shouldn't.
